A scan can start builds automatically for newly discovered or changed eligible pull requests, depending on the multibranch job’s branch-source triggers.

<proposed_plan>
# Report multibranch scan discoveries

## Summary

Enhance only `team scan`. It will wait for the requested Jenkins multibranch indexing operation, then report discovered `main` and eligible PR child jobs plus builds Jenkins newly queued or started because of that scan. Stellar, Perlmutter, and personal remain explicit-`run` workflows.

## Implementation Changes

- Capture a pre-scan snapshot of team child jobs and their build queue IDs.
- Request multibranch indexing, retain its queue location, and poll the root job’s indexing computation until completion (maximum five minutes).
- Fetch the post-scan child-job/build state and diff it against the pre-scan snapshot.
- Print:
  - `Found main (Jenkins job main)`
  - `Found PR #<number> (Jenkins job PR-<number>)`
  - one `Queued … as queue item …` plus queue URL line for every new build caused by this scan, including builds that began before reporting.
- Print an explicit “no builds scheduled” result when discovery created or updated no builds.
- On indexing failure or timeout, return nonzero with the multibranch job URL and retain any discovery/build information already available.
- Update team CLI help and documentation to describe scan as discovering configured branches/PRs and reporting Jenkins scheduling decisions.

## Test Plan

- Add mocked Jenkins API tests covering successful discovery with a new PR build, discovery with no new build, queue-to-build transition before reporting, and indexing failure/timeout.
- Verify the scan output includes only `main` and PR child jobs targeting `main`, preserves queue URLs, and does not require a GitHub token.
- Run shell syntax checks and the focused CLI test suite.

## Assumptions

- PR identity is reported as PR number plus Jenkins child-job name; source branch names are not fetched.
- `scan` blocks quietly until indexing completes, up to five minutes.
- Jenkins multibranch indexing uses the root folder computation API, consistent with the [Folders Plugin API](https://javadoc.jenkins.io/plugin/cloudbees-folder/com/cloudbees/hudson/plugins/folder/computed/ComputedFolder.html); its normal role is branch/PR discovery as documented for [Multibranch Pipeline](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/multibranch/).
</proposed_plan>

I’m implementing this as a team-only enhancement: it will snapshot branch jobs/build queue IDs, request indexing, wait for that computation, then report the discovered `main`/PR jobs and builds newly scheduled by the scan.
